mapper.select: SELECT cls.state_json AS classification_state, cls.revision AS classification_revision, song.id, song.source_id, source.name AS source_name, song.relative_path, song.file_size, song.modified_at, song.scanned_at, song.parser_profile_id, song.parser_revision, song.selected_rule_id, song.result_json, meta.track_json AS metadata_track, meta.fields_json AS metadata_fields, meta.applied_at AS metadata_applied_at, meta.origins_json AS metadata_origins, meta.fingerprint AS metadata_fingerprint FROM media_song song JOIN media_source source ON source.id = song.source_id LEFT JOIN song_metadata meta ON meta.song_id = song.id LEFT JOIN classification_song cls ON cls.song_id = song.id WHERE song.source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY song.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_song WHERE source_id = #{sourceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_song (id, source_id, relative_path, path_hash, file_size, modified_at, scanned_at, parser_profile_id, parser_revision, selected_rule_id, result_json, needs_review) VALUES (#{song.id}, #{song.sourceId}, #{song.relativePath}, #{song.pathHash}, #{song.fileSize}, #{song.modifiedAt}, #{song.scannedAt}, #{song.profileId}, #{song.revision}, #{song.ruleId}, #{song.resultJson}, #{song.needsReview})

where.if: AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM classification_assignment a JOIN classification_tag t ON t.id=a.tag_id AND t.active=1 WHERE a.song_id=song.id)
where.foreach: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM classification_assignment a JOIN classification_tag t ON t.id=a.tag_id AND t.active=1 WHERE a.song_id=song.id AND a.dimension=#{dimension} AND a.tag_id IN #{tag})
